item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Redis 8 in Azure Managed Redis
item.description:
Redis 8 is in public preview for Azure Managed Redis. The update adds richer queries, atomic JSON updates, field-level expiration, and finer-grained security.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure HorizonDB now integrates with Azure Advisor
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB is now generally available with Azure Advisor integration. Advisor analyzes HorizonDB resources and provides personalized recommendations to improve reliability and performance.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure SQL updates for mid-November 2026
item.description:
Azure SQL received mid-November 2026 updates, including fuzzy string matching for comparing strings by similarity rather than exact match. The provided article excerpt is truncated and does not include the full list of changes.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure HorizonDB supports PostgreSQL 18
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB is now in public preview with PostgreSQL 18 support. The service is a fully managed, PostgreSQL-compatible cloud-native database for scalable, high-performance workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: PG18 support for Azure Database for PostgreSQL elastic clusters
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL elastic clusters now support PostgreSQL 18. The update is available generally and is intended for new or existing distributed, cloud-scale workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates
